name: sgs/container
title: SGS Container
description: Flexible layout wrapper — the fundamental building block for all page sections. Breakout via WP-native align (wide/full toolbar); outer cap via maxWidth literal; inner band via contentWidth token (normal/wide/full) or literal.

sgs._comment_overlayNotAdopted: The background is the media system's `background` slot (supports.sgs.mediaElements, Spec 49 section 7.8): the Background panel is the shared media panel, and SGS_Container_Wrapper (via SGS_Background_Media) prints the element and overlay. An SVG drawn over a photo or video is the block's own kept layer (bgSvg* attributes).

wrapper.label: Wrapper
wrapper._note_border: R2c pattern (mirrors sgs/product-card, D-pending 2026-08-25): root border colour/width/style are block-private attrs (borderColour/borderColourGradient/borderWidth/borderStyle), not the native __experimentalBorder path — a single owner instead of the native Styles-tab colour panel and an SGS panel both writing style.border. Native __experimentalBorder is reduced to radius only (a corner-shape control, not a paint decision) and stays skip-serialised, emitted scoped via the style engine exactly as before. borderWidth has NO default (unset = no border, matching the padding attribute's no-default discipline right below) and is a base-only box object (no Tablet/Mobile siblings, matching product-card's own borderWidth).
wrapper._note_animation: The animation cluster (anim:*) has no member on this block: its motion is the sgsMotion model (Spec 38A), not attributes.
wrapper._note_typography: Typography migrated off the old WP-native supports.typography (fontSize/lineHeight/textAlign/letterSpacing/textTransform/fontWeight/fontStyle) onto the shared TypographyControls/sgs_typography_css_rule() mechanism (D971/D972 full-replacement track), root prefix '' (fontSize/fontSizeUnit/fontWeight/fontStyle/lineHeight/lineHeightUnit) — mirrors sgs/accordion. css:letter-spacing and css:text-transform are now honest gaps (no letterSpacing/textTransform control is offered); css:text-align keeps mapping to the block's own pre-existing textAlign attribute, unrelated to this migration.

inner.label: Inner (grid / flex layout)
inner._note: Grid/arrangement members map explicitly because this element declares no `prefix` — the default {prefix}{Suffix} convention cannot resolve a bare camelCase attribute. These are layout-cluster members: role=layout on a GRID element means arranging children, which the ELEMENT axis disambiguates from box-sizing on a tile element. Members with no attribute on this block (display, order, overflow, align-items) remain honest GAPs.

decorative.label: Decorative background
decorative._note: Background image/video (backgroundImage*/bgVideo*), background SVG (bgSvg*), overlay gradient (overlayGradient*), parallax/Ken Burns, and shape dividers (shapeDivider*) are governed by dedicated controls outside the Text/Fill/Layout style clusters, so this element declares none.

svg-bg.label: Background SVG
svg-bg._note: `.sgs-container__svg-bg`, the wrapper SGS_Container_Wrapper prints around a background or foreground SVG (bgSvg*). A motion target so a `draw` effect layer reaches the SVG's paths, where the flat `fx: draw` drew; it declares no style clusters because its look is governed by the bgSvg* controls.

background.label: Background
background._note: `.sgs-bg-media`, the element SGS_Container_Wrapper prints for every background (picture, tile layer, video or SVG). A motion target so a Ken Burns or parallax layer moves the background alone, never the block's content; it declares no style clusters because its look is governed by the Background panel.

background-video.label: Background video
background-video._note: The same `.sgs-bg-media` element when a device shows a video: an effect that suits video (not Ken Burns) reaches it through this part.

separators.description: The lines drawn between the items of a grid or flex layout (the shared Separators setting, includes/helpers-separators.php): { row: { style, width: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, colour }, column: { same } }. `row` is the line between rows, `column` between columns; an axis with no width draws nothing. Drawn centred in the gap by CSS gap decorations (column-rule / row-rule) where the browser has them, and by a small script painting the same lines elsewhere. Spacing only when empty.

surfaceBlur.description: Backdrop blur: a single CSS length (for example 24px) that blurs whatever sits behind this block. Emitted by SGS_Container_Wrapper via includes/helpers-surface-ground.php; empty emits nothing.

surfaceSaturate.description: Backdrop saturation as a whole-number percentage (for example 150), paired with surfaceBlur. Unset emits nothing; 0 is a legal value.

shadowHover.description: Hover-state box-shadow SHAPE (a preset slug or a layered shape), painted on :hover and :focus-within in place of the resting shape; colour comes from shadowColourHover, else shadowColour. Unset: the resting shape (with the automatic lift) applies.

overflow.description: Root overflow. 'clip' crops content that sticks out without making the container a scroll container, so position:sticky inside still works; 'hidden' crops and does make it one; 'visible' (default) prints nothing, leaving the shape-divider and SVG-background modes their own hidden. The sideways-scroll row (scrollSideways) paints on the items' row, not the root.

order.description: Position among the parent's grid or flex items, per device. Lower numbers come first; empty keeps the source order. Tablet inherits desktop until it sets its own.

boxAspectRatio.description: The block's shape as width / height (e.g. "4 / 5"); empty = sized by its content. Height then follows the width, never shorter than its content or Min height.

gridItemBorderGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the grid item's resting border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout, residual scope). Non-empty wins over gridItemBorder's colour component; width/style still come from gridItemBorder.

gridItemBorderGradientHover.description: CSS gradient string painting the grid item's hover-state border (D636 border-gradient rollout, residual scope). Non-empty wins on :hover/:focus-within; empty means no hover change.

flexWrap.description: Flex wrap. A plain 'wrap' or 'nowrap' string, or a per-device tier object {desktop,tablet,mobile} of the same two values (a chip row that scrolls sideways on phones and wraps on desktop).

scrollSideways.description: Scroll sideways, per device tier (on/off/inherit): the container's items sit in one native row that scrolls sideways and snaps into place. No GSAP, no pin (includes/container-scroll-row-css.php).

scrollRegionLabel.description: The accessible name of the sideways-scrolling row, read out when a keyboard or screen-reader user reaches it. Empty: the nearest heading before the row, then 'Scrolling row'.

scrollItemWidth.description: Per tier CSS length: the width of each item in a sideways-scrolling row. Unset: 80%.

hoverAsCard.description: Hover as one card: the container becomes a hover group without a link (data-sgs-hover-group on its root), so children whose hover settings follow the container play from one hover or focus anywhere on it. Off emits nothing.

pinEdge.description: Pin to edge, per device tier: 'top' or 'bottom' keeps the container stuck to that edge of its nearest scrolling ancestor (a drawer, a panel or the page) with the safe-area inset added to its padding on that edge; 'none' or unset is not pinned (includes/container-pin-edge-css.php). Unset everywhere emits nothing.

pinBelowHeader.description: Stop below the site header, per device tier ('on' or 'off', inheriting from the larger tier): at a tier where the pin resolves to 'top', the container sticks at the sticky header's height plus pinGap instead of sliding under it. Ignored inside drawers and pop-ups (includes/container-pin-edge-css.php).

meaning.what: Makes a pinned container stick just below the sticky site header instead of sliding under it.
meaning.trigger: scrolling, while the container is pinned at the top

value.unit: tier object {desktop,tablet,mobile} (desktop: on or off; tablet and mobile: inherit, on or off)

pinGap.description: Gap below the header, per device tier: a CSS length or spacing preset slug, added to the header height when pinBelowHeader is on. Unset: the shop filter's spacing (var(--wp--preset--spacing--40, 1.5rem)).

padding.description: TIER-of-BOXES: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each tier a {top,right,bottom,left} box (Phase 2 tier-object migration, 2026-09-06 — matches the shape already shipped on sgs/site-header-row/sgs/site-footer-row/sgs/gallery). Owned outright (no supports.spacing — D555 box-object migration). NO DESKTOP DEFAULT: the horizontal gutter is supplied by WordPress core's own .has-global-padding, which the shared wrapper applies whenever the container renders a content band (class-sgs-container-wrapper.php, search has-global-padding). A 24px default lived here from f9f4368b until 2026-08-21 and was REVERTED: a per-instance default has no nesting reset, so it compounded to 72px on a 3-deep nest and left a 48px-wide footer container with zero content. Core's mechanism carries the nesting reset; a hand-rolled copy cannot. Do NOT reintroduce a default here.

margin.description: TIER-of-BOXES: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each tier a {top,right,bottom,left} box (Phase 2 tier-object migration, 2026-09-06).

borderColour.description: Wrapper root border colour (R2c pattern — block-private, replaces the native __experimentalBorder.color path). Empty = no border colour; the colour only emits when some side has a border width and borderStyle is not 'none'.

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the wrapper's border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over borderColour, matching sgs/product-card.

borderWidth.description: Wrapper root border width {top,right,bottom,left}, base-only (no Tablet/Mobile siblings — matches sgs/product-card's own borderWidth). NO DEFAULT (unset = no border), same no-hardcoded-default discipline as the padding attribute above.

borderStyle.description: Wrapper root border style. Empty = solid once any side has a width (sgs_border_box_decls); 'none' = no border rendered regardless of colour/width.

textColour.description: Resting root text colour, bound to the wrapper element's css:color. A section-KIND block can parent arbitrary content, so this is a root-scoped INHERITABLE cascade default for whatever the client nests inside — not a duplicate of a child's own control (HC2 carve-out, Bean-ruled 2026-08-21).

textColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the resting root text colour (background-clip: text) instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over textColour at render time, mirroring sgs/hero.

headingColour.description: Colour of every h1..h6 inside the section, printed as a (0,1,0) `:where()` rule that beats the theme's heading colour and the automatic on-dark heading colour; a heading block's own colour still wins.

headingColourGradient.description: Gradient for the headings inside this section, painted through background-clip:text with a flat-colour fallback. Empty = the flat Heading colour.

textColourHover.description: Hover/focus root text colour. Sibling of textColour; declared so the state is reachable (a state without a base is an asymmetric control surface).

textColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient for the hover root text colour. Non-empty wins over textColourHover.

fontSize.description: Root wrapper typography (D971/D972 full-replacement track, mirrors sgs/accordion) — replaces the retired WP-native supports.typography.fontSize. Consumed by sgs_typography_css_rule() via the shared TypographyControls component, prefix ''.
